variant.briefing:
You don't need all the details, but Headhunters have an interest in what happens over at [Location] and I just got word they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. 

The dumb sods are trying to cripple the place by taking out their [Objects]. I'm not having it.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed. These chumps are lightweights so shouldn't be too much of a problem for you to handle. 

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw [ScripAmount] Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows
